'''Tam Daral''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. Along with other workers of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] he used the [[Bounty Brokers Association]] to put a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on former [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] executive [[Samovan Bann]], who allied himself with the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]].
